newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary OTP Sec initiates TVK with "buy".
newsitem.headline: Hungary OTP Sec initiates TVK with "buy".

text.p: Hungary's OTP Securities gave an initial rating of "buy" to stocks in chemicals company Tiszai Vegyi Kombinat (TVK) Rt, despite its high exposure to the chemicals cycle.
"We still consider TVK shares to be undervalued by 10 to 12 percent," analyst Zoltan Nemeth said in a company report.
TVK's high level of vertical integration is both an asset and a liability, the analyst said.

"TVK's most important competitive advantage is that it is able to achieve considerable cost savings due to vertical integration," he said, adding that "because of its limited product portfolio... prices for all of its products fluctuate in concert on the world market".
Inexpensive labour and relatively low energy prices also provided TVK with a competitive edge, Nemeth said.
"Due to a recent decline in (Hungarian) real wages, wage costs have declined further relative to those in west Europe," he said.
Depending on the chemicals cycle in 1997, Nemeth forecasts a pre-tax margin of 15.1 percent for a low-growth scenario and a 17.1 percent margin in case of a high-growth scenario.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange, TVK shares closed at 2,625 forints, down 60.
